description: This file defines a React functional component named MCPServers responsible for displaying and managing MCP server configurations. It includes data fetching via react-query, state management, filtering, deletion, and rendering of either a list of servers or a detailed view. It also integrates with external UI libraries like @tremor/react, antd, and icons.

methods.name: confirmDelete
methods.description: Handles the confirmation of delete operation for an MCP server, calls deleteMCPServer, refetches data, and shows notification.

methods.name: cancelDelete
methods.description: Handles cancellation of delete modal without deleting.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Sets the server ID to delete and opens the delete confirmation modal.

methods.name: handleCreateSuccess
methods.description: Adds a newly created MCP server to the list and closes the creation modal.
